National outreach package covering **1 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the

## Audience

- Tunisia ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Tunisia national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Tunisia public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Tunisia in the United Kingdom — economic section
